title: 市场广度扩大：多元化配置正当时，AI集中风险如何化解？
speaker: Unknown

segments.en: and credit markets are investors seeking for those credit alternatives right now is it still the equity space to play that so I think credit spreads are very tight and generally we don't see much value in credit right now
segments.zh: 信贷市场方面，投资者在寻找信贷替代品，现在是否仍应通过权益市场参与？我认为信贷利差很紧，目前信贷价值不大。

segments.en: but we are positive structurally on the AI story when we look at the equity side though I think right now we're slogging for more diversified approach as I said earlier high quality stocks were looking cheap by the end of June now they rallied a bit but there's still opportunity there
segments.zh: 但我们结构性看好AI主题。在权益方面，我们倾向于多元化策略。6月底高质量股票看起来便宜，现在有所反弹，但仍有机会。

segments.en: value as a style is also very interesting diversifying to AI risk and doing well so actually the story of the empty market now is much broader
segments.zh: 价值风格也很有趣，可以分散AI风险，表现不错。实际上，现在股市的故事更加广泛。

segments.en: so we think now is a time to be fairly diversified we've been so used to momentum of being the factor to chase on AI as some momentum's gone in your view there because it's broadening out how are you looking at that
segments.zh: 因此我们认为现在是多元化配置的时候。我们习惯了追逐AI动能，但动能已经减弱，因为市场广度在扩大，你怎么看？

segments.en: there was it so in recent years initially you had a situation where actually high high quality high momentum stocks were doing well you know when the hyperscalers were doing really well that was the initial story just this year we've seen momentum doing well while quality really did poorly
segments.zh: 近年来，最初高质量高动能股票表现良好，超大规模企业表现强劲。但今年，动能表现好，而质量表现差。

segments.en: so it was that divergence which was very reminiscent of what we saw in Q1 2000 so I don't like seeing that momentum when it's backed by quality is fine okay we have momentum and quality underperforming and that divergence was worrying to me
segments.zh: 这种分化让人想起2000年一季度。我不喜欢看到动能脱离质量，动能和质量表现分化令我担忧。

segments.en: now of course frothinist could return no question but for now we certainly think that it's better to to be more diversified take advantage of that opportunity in quality
segments.zh: 当然，泡沫可能重现，但就目前而言，我们认为最好更加多元化，利用质量股的机会。

segments.en: I sometimes describe it as an eclipse it's unusual to see quality and value out overlap for moment at the end of June we have that eclipse
segments.zh: 我有时称之为“日食”，质量股和价值股重叠很不寻常，6月底我们就看到了这种“日食”。
